actions: Preserve PVC identity, timestamp, and marker evidence in reports.
Do not interpret local-path persistence as HA or backup.
analysis: Persistence evidence is tied to unchanged PVCs and exact query timestamps, not to a vague claim that storage survived.
cautions: Single worker local-path storage is not replicated and can be lost with the node disk.
excerpt: - 数据持久化：见 `evidence/persistence.json`。Prometheus 与 Loki Pod UID 均改变，原 PVC 相同；固定查询时间的指标值仍为 67，重建前 marker 的原时间戳和日志全文完全相同。
rollback: Restore the workload and re-query the same fixed time and marker.
title: Pod 重建后 PVC 持久化
